item.title: New Farm Aid Merch Features Wool and Cotton from Family Farmers
item.description: Our winter 2026 collection features a wool hat from the sheep on Hickory Hills Farm, plus other items that are have a direct connection to family farmers.

item.title: Nathaniel Rateliff Joins Farm Aid Board of Directors
item.description: "I look forward to working together to continue educating the public on the struggles family farmers face and to raise money to support them for a better future."

item.title: Farm Aid Partners with the Univ. of Texas to Help Farmers Prepare for Disaster
item.description: A comprehensive look at the existing options farmers have for accessing much-needed disaster resource programs.

item.title: Farm Aid's "Breaking Bread" Explores Stories of Everyday People's Fight for Justice
item.description: How have food and farm movements informed the decisions we make everyday? The lives we lead? The places we call home?

item.title: Navigating Disaster Assistance for Farmers Training – Farm Aid
item.description: Assistance from federal programs can make a world of difference for farmers after a disaster. Learn more about programs available to farmers.

item.title: Farm Aid 40: Live from the FarmYard Stage – Farm Aid
item.description: Join us for a panel recorded at Farm Aid 40 on our FarmYard Stage. Our guests include farmer Amanda Koehler, activist Lisa Bellanger and Farm Aid artist Madeline Edwards. Tune in to hear about the challenges faced by new farmers and emerging artists—and the hopes that keep them moving forward.

item.title: Watch videos from our trip to a Pennsylvania farm conference – Farm Aid
item.description: Join our trip to the Pasa Sustainable Agriculture Conference in Lancaster, PA. Get inspired and learn what farmers get out of conferences like this one.

item.title: The Latest Updates on the Farm Bill – Farm Aid
item.description: The Farm Bill is a huge piece of legislation and its path to become a law will be filled with twists and turns. Here are the latest updates.

item.title: Breaking Bread — In Conversation with Shirlette Ammons — Farm Aid
item.description: We spoke with shirlette ammons about her podcast series "Tending," which tells the stories of Black farmers involved in a historic fight against the USDA.

item.title: USDA’s Proposed Delay of Poultry Rule is an Unfair Loss for Farmers – Farm Aid
item.description: Farm Aid strongly opposes a proposal by USDA to delay a long-awaited rule to protect contract poultry growers.
